buttons.label: Keep it: this is the one judge path. Reword SR-134 to say a calibrated judge model may confirm a requirement or decision that your verified words support, above your auto-approve threshold
Undo it: a 'supported' verdict only sends the record to a trial card, and only the judge reading your reply to a read-back (EX-3) confirms
Keep it, but only when auto-approve is on and the trial cards show it's calibrated, and fix the file's note that says nothing is confirmed from a verdict alone
